text.transcriptHint: One line per turn. Start each line with Agent: or Customer: so Sinji can tell the speakers apart. Lines without a prefix continue the previous speaker.
text.placeholder:
Agent: Good afternoon, how can I help?
Customer: I would like to repay my loan early.
text.sample:
Agent: Good afternoon, thank you for calling. How can I help?
Customer: Hello. I want to repay my consumer loan early. Is there a fee?
Agent: Early repayment in the first 12 months carries a fee of 1% of the repaid amount. After 12 months it is free.
Customer: And how long does the repayment take to show in my account?
Agent: The balance updates within 1 business day.
Customer: Thank you, that is clear.
Agent: You are welcome. Is there anything else I can do for you?
